# 1, 6 tree lines." This fixture is what a golden transcript relocates that
# memory into (§4.4's strongest surviving attack, recorded verbatim in D-353's
# sibling ADR line for this commit).

# REGENERATION DISCIPLINE (D-209's, quoted in U1_gate_supersession.md §4.4):
